technique_name: Create a spreadsheet to track monthly expenses
description: The spreadsheet should have a simple, user-friendly layout and should include columns for each month with titles such as “Date”, “Category”, “Sub-Category”, “Description”, “Amount” and “Net”. The first row should contain headers defining these columns. Underneath the headers, the user should be able to document the date, category of the expense, sub-category (if applicable), a brief description of the expense, the amount of the expense and a running total for the month.
